statement: Golden-ratio spacing among technology emergence dates in this catalogue is indistinguishable from chance, and the phi detector in src/shadow_search.py is retained as a negative control rather than as a finding.
rationale: src/shadow_search.py shipped a phi-ratio detector whose output was reported as possible evidence of 'underlying systemic coupling patterns'. That is a strong empirical claim and it had never been compared against a null model. The first run compared it. The catalogue contains 2065 phi-spaced triads; dates thrown at random into the same window produce 2229 on average, p = 0.864 — the corpus has slightly fewer than chance would give. The claim was not weakened, it was replaced. What the detector is good for now is calibration: it is the control that shows how readily this kind of search manufactures pattern from 55 dates and a 52,000-year window.
prediction: The number of phi-spaced triads among catalogue start dates does not exceed the number found in the same count of dates drawn uniformly from the same window, at p < 0.05 over 300 seeded trials.

measures.target: cross-domain systemic coupling among the technologies in this catalogue
measures.rendering: the golden-ratio triad detector in src/shadow_search.py, run against a seeded uniform null over catalogue start dates
measures.target_question: Does cross-domain systemic coupling exist among these technologies, and what would measure it? The phi rendering was falsified; the target it was aimed at was never reached.
measures.note: Added retroactively when CLAUDE.md RULE 1 was written. At run-001-baseline the phi RENDERING was falsified (p = 0.97 at run-005-recent-finds; 0.864 at the baseline run). The claim was replaced by its own negation and H007 now reports supported, which is correct about the rendering and says nothing about the target. Nothing in this repository has measured cross-domain coupling; the detector that was going to is a negative control. The target is open at U-H007-3.

revisions.was: Technology emergence dates in the catalogue cluster at golden-ratio intervals more often than chance, indicating systemic coupling.
revisions.became: Golden-ratio spacing among technology emergence dates in this catalogue is indistinguishable from chance, and the phi detector is retained as a negative control.
revisions.because: Falsified against a seeded uniform null model: observed 2065 phi-triads vs null mean 2229.2, p = 0.864. The direction of the test was inverted along with the claim, so a future corpus that genuinely does show phi structure will falsify the replacement in turn.

last_result.summary: phi-triads (9141) indistinguishable from chance (null mean 10415.0, p=0.983) — negative control holds
